responsibility: This scheduling description models the original Niagara (UltraSPARC T1) as a single-issue processor. It defines instruction latencies for integer operations, loads/stores, branches, floating-point moves/compare/multiply/divide, and VIS-class instructions under cpu=niagara, giving the scheduler a Niagara-specific timing model distinct from later Niagara2/3/4/7 files.
